concept: S3 Versioning + MFA Delete: protection from accidental deletion/overwrite
tests: Which S3 features protect objects from accidental deletion and overwrite.
expected: S3 Versioning (restore previous versions) + MFA Delete (MFA required to permanently delete versions and disable versioning). Triggers: "accidental deletion and overwrite", "protect objects".
why_not: CRR helps with DR but doesn't by itself prevent deletion in the bucket; Transfer Acceleration speeds up uploads; Requester Pays changes who pays.
